fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using a path parsing issue in winsat.exe (UACMe 52)
fields.name: UAC Bypass Abusing Winsat Path Parsing - Process
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.integrityLevel in ("High","System","S-1-16-16384","S-1-16-12288")) and src.process.image.path contains "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\system32\\winsat.exe" and src.process.cmdline contains "C:\\Windows \\system32\\winsat.exe"))
